name: Resizable Kamen Rider Wizard Ring Snap

captions.detailed: This 3D model features a customizable, octagonal-shaped split ring designed to function as a snap-on connector. The main body is an eight-sided ring with a flat, rectangular plate attached to its back outer wall. Opposite to the plate, the ring has an open gap, creating a flexible C-shape that allows it to spring open and snap onto cylindrical objects. A small, tapered cylindrical peg protrudes from the outer face of the rectangular plate, serving as a snap-fit connector point.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric snap-on ring with an octagonal outer profile and a flat mounting plate. The user should be able to adjust the ring's inner diameter using US ring sizes, along with its width and wall thickness. Ensure the ring has a gap on one side for flexibility and a tapered mounting peg on the back of the rectangular plate.
captions.factory: The design begins by importing 'MCAD/shapes.scad' to utilize the octagon primitive. A 'ring' module is defined, which uses boolean differences to subtract a smaller inner octagon from a larger outer octagon, followed by subtracting a cube to create the front opening gap. Outside the module, a rectangular cube is translated and positioned to form the back plate. A small tapered cylinder is then rotated and translated onto the outer face of the back plate to act as the snap peg.
